notes: Release iron rules, real full-text search, a community panel, and a fully translated console. Iron rules: the repository now ships docs/publish_iron_rules.md - the two-zone model (development home vs public artifact), the deny-by-default publish manifest as the single source of truth, the mandatory pre-release desensitization audit over the tree, the full git history and the release notes, the credential discipline (zero echo, child-environment exports only, release notes inside the leak scan), the tag-and-release integrity checklist with every breakpoint verified, the same-car number-sync duty, the public-repository standing rules, and the No-Go ladder. It ships with deploy/pre_release_audit.py, an executable auditor that scans the tracked tree minus deny files, the complete history and optionally the published release notes, reports per-class hits with declared exceptions, and exits GO/NO-GO. Sessions search is now real full-text: SQLite FTS5 with a persistent index kept outside every byte-identity assertion surface, lazy mtime-based sync, BM25 ranking, Chinese handled through single-character tokens plus adjacent phrases, and an honest fallback that labels itself substring with a reason whenever FTS5 is unavailable; deleted or rotated-out sessions can never be matched again, which is asserted. Community: a new Community view in the console lists this repository's GitHub Discussions through a server-side route cached for ten minutes with anonymous reads, honest unavailability reasons (the repository is still private at build time, which is a designed state, not a failure), category filtering, a deep link to open a new discussion, and sanitized hrefs; the repository also gains discussion rules, a contributing guide, a security policy and a code of conduct under .github/. Locale packs grew from 662 to 795 keys: an inventory of every user-facing string that was rendered inline instead of through the packs (54 missing t() keys, 4 dangling data-i18n references, and 60-plus static labels, placeholders, titles and enumerated options) is now wired and translated in both English and Chinese, key sets strictly identical. Verification: core 1596 to 1607 (+11 search tests), console smoke 234/234, source lint 0/68 with packs 795/795, ten probes green (parity alpha 19, gamma 35, delta1 41, delta2 51, delta3 42, delta4 37, mission card, mission board, onboard 33, inbound health 17), the 17-leg real-machine E2E series green, frontend UI legs 33/50/20, site gates 62 + 59, screenshots 7/7, publish gate READY(0), and the new audit tool reporting GO with zero history hits after the scheduled history sanitization.
